title: Roast Paella
description: A flavorful Spanish-inspired paella dish made with chorizo and shrimp, served with a side of fresh vegetables.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large paella pan over medium-high heat.
Add the chorizo and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion, garlic, and bell pepper and cook, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables are tender, about 8 minutes.
Add the tomato and cook, stirring occasionally, for 2 minutes.
Stir in the paella rice and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Add the chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20-25 minutes or until the rice is cooked and the liquid has been absorbed.
Stir in the shrimp and cook, uncovered, until pink and cooked through, about 5 minutes.
Remove from heat and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
